questions.q: If $A$ is a $3 \times 4$ matrix, what is the shape of $A^T$?
questions.explain: Transposing swaps rows and columns: $(r, c) \to (c, r)$.
$(A^T)_{ij} = A_{ji}$: the value is preserved, only its address flips from $(2, 3)$ to $(3, 2)$.
Flipping across the main diagonal twice sends every entry back home: $(A^T)^T = A$.

questions.q: For $A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \end{bmatrix}$, what is the **second column** of $A^T$?
questions.explain: Row $i$ of $A$ becomes column $i$ of $A^T$ in the same order, so column 2 of $A^T$ is row 2 of $A$: $(4, 5, 6)$.
